<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Run the SLAM weigh-check on a sealed package"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/packages/{id}/slam-runs"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



SLAM = Scan, Label, Apply, Manifest. Weighs a sealed package: if `|actualWeight - expectedWeight|` is within tolerance (0.05, same unit as the two weights — e.g. kilograms), a shipping label is applied (`LabelApplied`); otherwise the package is diverted (`WeightDiscrepancyDetected` + `PackageDiverted`) rather than shipped with a wrong manifest. Idempotent in effect once processed: a repeat call on an already-labeled-or-diverted package returns `409` rather than re-processing it.

  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-supplied key, 1-128 printable ASCII characters (a UUID minted once per LOGICAL submit; a retry reuses it, a new user action mints a new one). Required on every POST: a missing key is `400 idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one `400 idempotency-key-invalid`. The key is global to the service: a retry with the same method, path and body replays the stored answer (status, body and `Location`) with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` and runs nothing; the same key with a different method, path or body is `409 idempotency-key-reused`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"pattern":"^[ -~]+$","example":"6f1c2a3e-9b1d-4c1a-8f0e-2d5b7c9a1e44"}},{"name":"id","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The package id, as returned by `POST /tasks/{id}/package-seals`.","schema":{"type":"string","example":"20260101T120200.000000000"}}]}
